newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - N.J. Casino Reinvestment Auth.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - N.J. Casino Reinvestment Auth.

text.p: SUMMARY OF NOTICE OF BOND SALE - BOOK-ENTRY ONLY
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by representatives of the Casino Reinvestment Development Authority (the
Authority'') at the offices of St. John & Wayne, L.L.C., 2 Penn Plaza East, Newark, New Jersey 07105-2249, on

until 11:00 a.m., New Jersey time, at which time they will be publicly opened and announced, for the purchase of the Authority's Parking Fee Revenue Bonds dated June 1, 1997 and due on October 1, as follows (collectively, the Bonds'');
$90,000,000 Parking Fee Revenue Bonds Series 1997 A,
maturing in the following principal amounts:* $2,730,000 in
the year 2016; and $7,090,000 in the year 2017.
Individual purchases of beneficial ownership interests in the Bonds will be made in book-entry form (without

certificates) in the denomination of $5,000 each or integral multiples thereof. All the Bonds of the same maturity must bear a single rate of interest in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder. Interest shall be calculated on the basis of a 360 day year of twelve 30-day months, payable on October 1, 1997 and semi-annually on each April 1 and October 1 thereafter until maturity. The Bonds maturing on or after October 1, 2008 are subject to redemption at the option of the Authority in accordance with the Notice of Sale dated May 20, 1997 (the
Sale''). Additionally, the Bonds will be subject to

Extraordinary Mandatory Redemption and Mandatory Sinking Fund Redemption as described in such Notice of Sale. The Authority will accept the proposal which shall result in the lowest true interest cost to the Authority over the life of the Bonds computed as described in the Notice of Sale. No bids for less than all the Bonds will be considered.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Notice of Sale, the Form of Proposal and other documents relating to the Bonds may be obtained, so long as available, from the Authority's Financial Advisor, Public Resources Advisory Group, 40 Rector Street, Suite 1600, New York, New York 10006-2908, Attention: Steven Peyser (Telephone 212-566- 7800).
